channel.title: Font Awesome incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Font Awesome's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Major Outage [resolved]
item.description: All services are restored. This appears to have been an issue with our CDN.

item.title: Partial outage for some services provided through Cloudflare [resolved]
item.description: Cloudflare is in global recovery mode and we haven't seen any errors for the past half hour. We're going to consider this resolved but continue watching it until the outage is completely resolved on the Cloudflare side.
